about_the_game:
The White Cat’s Dark Affair is a Cyberpunk Hitman Thriller. You are The White Cat, a professional killer navigating a dystopian future, entangled in a global murderous plot. This is a short-form narrative game designed for players who value unique experiences.

Features

  • Minimalist point-and-click gameplay

  • Focused narrative in a contained, stylized world

  • Narrative-first gameplay with meaningful interactive elements

  • Hand-crafted pixel art in a retro-cyberpunk aesthetic

  • Stylized pixel visuals using 2D lighting, rim highlights, and post-processed effects

  • High-quality sound design and original soundtrack

  • First title in the expanded The White Cat Universe

  • Multi-platform release: PC, Mac, Linux

content_descriptors.notes: Nudity, mention of violence, assassination, use of alcohol and drugs.
